description: This file contains utility functions for network interface management, IP address handling, route table retrieval, and IPv6 address comparison, primarily used within the COSA framework for device management.

methods.name: CosaUtilStringToHex
methods.description: Converts a string of hex characters to a byte array.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetIfAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of a network interface.

methods.name: CosaSListPushEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Inserts a context link object into a list based on its instance number.

methods.name: CosaSListGetEntryByInsNum
methods.description: Retrieves a context link object from a list by its instance number.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetLowerLayers
methods.description: Finds the lower layer interface path matching a keyword within specified tables.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetFullPathNameByKeyword
methods.description: Finds the full path name of a parameter matching a keyword in specified tables.

methods.name: CosaUtilChannelValidate
methods.description: Validates if a given WiFi channel is valid for a specific radio and channel list.

methods.name: CosaUtilIoctlXXX
methods.description: Performs ioctl operations on network interfaces, such as getting/setting MTU, status, and netmask.

methods.name: CosaUtilGetStaticRouteTable
methods.description: Retrieves static route entries from the system routing table.

methods.name: CosaDmlV6AddrIsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two IPv6 addresses are equal.

methods.name: CosaDmlV6PrefIsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two IPv6 prefix strings are equal.
